label: End of long original sequence (last token / <DEL>), sparse, b-first and h-input enriched
explanation: Fires only at the end of the original phase of long sequences (L=8-9 carry 95% of mass): the last one or two original tokens and the <DEL> step (t=6-9). It never fires in the copy phase or at t<5. Within that window it is very sparse (about 1% of eligible steps), and which sequences light up depends on content: sequences starting with b (11x lift; r and g about 4x), with d among the early tokens, and with h as the last original input (7.5x lift, holding the strongest activations, e.g. b r d w b k c [h]). Conjunctions of these history cues raise precision to about 0.2-0.25 but lose most recall, so the content condition is not captured. The positional predicate covers about 77% of mass at very low precision.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: orig0=b (+6.27), recall_idx=-1 & in_tok=h (+4.99), orig0=r (+4.57), orig2=d (+4.28), orig0=g (+4.20), orig1=b (+3.46). Lower it: phase=2 (-7.86), prev3_tok=- (-5.04), t=3 (-3.99), t=4 (-3.90).
